summary.headline: Choosing the Significator
summary.text: Rules for identifying the significator in interrogations from the ascendant lord, Moon, Sun, house lords, and angular planets; the cause and outcome are judged from the planets separating from or joined to the significator. An example begins with an ascendant at 10° Taurus and Venus, its ruler, in Cancer.
